sources.entry: Plainsay - Free MIT-licensed Mac dictation with on-device Whisper and Parakeet (Apple silicon, macOS 14+).

summary.one_liner: Plainsay is a free, MIT-licensed native macOS dictation app that transcribes speech locally with Whisper or Parakeet models and pastes the result at the cursor.
summary.what_it_does: Hold a shortcut (Right Command by default, or tap for toggle mode), speak, and release to get text inserted at the cursor, or left on the clipboard if no safe paste target is found. Local mode runs WhisperKit (Whisper) or FluidAudio (NVIDIA Parakeet) Core ML models on the Mac after a one-time model download. Optional Polishing, run through a selected provider, a local endpoint, or Plainsay Cloud, cleans up transcripts and falls back to the raw transcript on timeout or failure. Voice Edit lets you correct the last dictation or edit selected text in other apps by voice or typed request. Model files are checked against expected digests before loading, and History keeps transcripts locally for a chosen retention period. Each dictation is capped at 10 minutes.
use_cases: dictate text into any Mac app
voice typing into emails and documents
dictate with a local Whisper or Parakeet model
correct or rewrite selected text by voice
how_to_run: Or download the notarized DMG from the project's releases and drag Plainsay to Applications
Choose 'On this Mac' for Local mode and pick a recommended model (about 475–632 MB multilingual, about 150 MB English-only)
Grant Microphone, Accessibility, and Input Monitoring permissions
Hold Right Command, speak, and release
notable: Local transcription with no account, no telemetry, and recognition that works offline after the model download
Committed benchmark harness reporting word error rate and latency on a disclosed LibriSpeech sample
Model integrity check that hashes downloaded Core ML files against digests shipped in the signed bundle
Returns focus to the window you started in before pasting, and refuses to paste elsewhere
Voice Edit with preview and highlighted diff for correcting dictations or editing selected text
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or newer and an Apple-silicon Mac
Voice Edit and correction commands require v0.2.34 or later; Plainsay Cloud does not yet support editing commands
Optional Plainsay Cloud subscription costs US$4 gross/month and includes 900 transcription minutes per rolling 30 days; it sends audio to the service
Benchmark results are on a 50-clip English sample and are not a claim about other languages or noisy audio
